featured_reviews.name: Frenney Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
BEWARE SCAMMERS - everyone is a FRAUD including staff and shop manager

I went to purchase locks and 50+ handles on 14/09/2025 on the recommendation of my carpenter. I was looking for brass handles and the sales person confidently showed me rose coloured handles no. 5043 Decorita brand saying they are made of brass. I even paid 10k deposit as I was happy with the options they had and my selection which was shortlived.

Thankfully I went to another shop the following day in the suburbs and I was made aware by an honest shopkeeper that the handles I selected are made of "steel" and that's when I realised I was cheated. This shopkeeper even showed me the catalogue and showed me that the handle no. 5043 Decorita brand was indeed steel.

I confronted Chandni hardware sales person on 18/09/2025 to show me the catalogue for the handle no. 5043 but he denied having a catalogue for the same saying they don't get catalogues for all brands and kept insisting the handle is made of brass and I had to believe him that's it and that there was no other way to prove the material is brass. This is against Consumer Protection Act of 2019 violating the Right to be informed. The shop owner /Manager and sales person also started arguing with me probably thinking I am a lady and I won't be able to catch their bull shit. I showed them the proof of the catalogue picture. I told them as a customer it is my right to know the printed price and the material used in printed form.

Finally since I had paid the 10k, I was forced to take some of the items which when I cross checked the price with another shop, are actually highly priced. featured_reviews.name: Kiran Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: Best place to find vast range of hardware at good price & service they offer.

featured_reviews.name: Subir Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wide variety of different categories of hardware for the entire house, most of them the conventional type spread across two floors.
Service is not that customer focused, they seem to be more busy in talking with others. Also, no photography is allowed inside the premises so no chance to share pics with your family to seek their help in decision making.
Also, I understand that they do not return or exchange products. Very absurd in today's competitive scenario!

Update 25/08/22
While photography is still not permitted, one can do a video call and show the products of your interest to your people to make decisions.
Also exchange was permitted on request for some items.
Prices are reasonable, no negotiations!

featured_reviews.name: Jinay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Purohit Hardware and was thoroughly impressed by their wide range of products. Whether you're looking for basic tools or specialized hardware, they have it all! The staff is knowledgeable and helpful, always ready to assist with any questions or recommendations. Overall, a fantastic experience .

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rude staff. Don't know customer handling. No bargain even the products are not from fixed MRP. Don't allow to click picture and products are non returnable so if they send incorrect item you are left with no proof.
There are better cost shops in borivali itself, prefer them avoid this. Let these guys come down to ground and learn customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Saumil Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Very poor customer service. Did not have many of the designs. When shown a particular design required they asked me to bring in the sample. Other designs they flat out refused, which I could get easily at other shops. The only good thing was that they had prices listed alongside all their wares.
